source.name: US Lecce, 'Banca Popolare Pugliese è “sleeve sponsor” di maglia'
source.quote: presenza del marchio “BPP” sulle maniche delle maglie dei giocatori impegnati nel campionato di Serie A TIM

note: Sleeve-sponsor agreement announced 26 Aug 2023, which BPP called its seventh consecutive year alongside the club; the partnership predates this deal and its original start isn't separately sourced. BPP's own site confirms it as sleeve sponsor for 2026/2027 (bpp.it, 3 Aug 2026). No deal value reported.
